functions.name: central
functions.description: Federated Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA) that finds linear combinations of features best separating two or more classes across multiple organizations without sharing raw data

arguments.name: class_col
arguments.description: Column name containing the class labels.

arguments.name: features
arguments.description: List of numeric column names to use as features. If None, all numeric columns are used.

arguments.name: n_components
arguments.description: Number of discriminant components to return. If None, returns min(n_classes - 1, n_features) components.
